definitions.explanation: An inherent quality or attribute that distinguishes something from others. Often used in technical and academic contexts for the properties of materials, devices, or natural phenomena.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{素材|そざい}→素材：09492_sozai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{特性|とくせい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{調|しら}べる→調べる：01213_shiraberu⟧。
examples.english: To examine the properties of this material.

examples.japanese: ⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{特性|とくせい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{生|い}かした⟦{商品|しょうひん}→商品：01436_shouhin⟧⟦{開発|かいはつ}→開発：06746_kaihatsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{進|すす}んでいる→進む：01225_susumu⟧。
examples.english: Product development that leverages the distinctive characteristics of the region is progressing.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{薬|くすり}→薬：00793_kusuri⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{溶|と}け→溶ける：02302_tokeru⟧やすい⟦という→という：09577_toiu⟧{特性|とくせい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}っている→持つ：00478_motsu⟧。
examples.english: This medicine has the characteristic of being easily soluble in water.

notes:
USAGE:
{特性|とくせい} emphasizes inherent, distinguishing properties — qualities that are built-in rather than acquired. It is more technical than ⟦{特徴|とくちょう}→特徴：03456_tokuchou⟧ (feature, characteristic), which describes any noticeable trait. {特性|とくせい} is preferred when discussing material properties, device specifications, or scientific attributes.

Note: The homophone ⟦{特製|とくせい}→特製：13534_tokusei⟧ (specially made) is a different word.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {特性|とくせい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{生|い}かす: to make use of characteristics
- {特性|とくせい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}つ→持つ：00478_motsu⟧: to have a property
- ⟦{材料|ざいりょう}→材料：02831_zairyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{特性|とくせい}: material properties
- ⟦{電気|でんき}→電気：09780_denki⟧{特性|とくせい}: electrical characteristics
- {特性|とくせい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{分析|ぶんせき}する→分析する：25338_bunsekisuru⟧: to analyze properties
